user.title: Authorize Quark Cloud Drive
user.description:
Paste a Quark Drive authorization code (starts with `AAC-` or `CAC-`); the integration exchanges it directly, no QR scanning needed.

To get a code: open the Quark Drive web → click the avatar (top-right) → select "Drive Skill authorization" → copy the code on the page. The code is masked; paste it into any text editor to view it.

Note: codes are single-use and short-lived; paste it promptly after obtaining it.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Quark Cloud Drive. Check your network and retry.
error.invalid_auth_code: The authorization code is invalid. Codes are single-use and short-lived; get a new one and retry.
error.expired: The authorization code has expired. Get a new one.
error.already_authorized: This account is already authorized for this device. Revoke the authorization in the Quark app (Me → Login authorization management) or remove and re-add this integration entry.
